trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: The Platinum pops on its own once the other 54 are earned. Nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. No online play, no DLC and no difficulty setting is involved — one playthrough is enough, at roughly 200 hours.

steps.text: Work through the roadmap stages in order; the Platinum unlocks the moment the 54th other trophy pops.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, in case you want to replay the ending, and never use cheats on this save — cheats switch off trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Play the story and it pops on its own.

steps.text: Play Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy is awarded once Chapter 2 begins, after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1 to its end.
Start Chapter 2 and finish What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops then, not on the last Chapter 1 cutscene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy is awarded once Chapter 3 begins, after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
Start Chapter 3 and finish Welcome to Vice City — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The trophy is awarded after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3 to its end, including The Cartel Heist.
Start Chapter 4 and finish Ocean Beach and Another Life — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.
Finish Starting From Zero, the final mission of Chapter 4 — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy — pops automatically and cannot be missed. The chapter it belongs to is disputed (see below), not whether it can be missed.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and the ending is the one moment you may want to revisit.

steps.text: Play the story through to its final mission and finish it.
Save manually just before the final mission — there is no mission replay, so this save is your only way back.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends; free roam continues afterwards, so all cleanup can wait until after the credits. Lists that name a chapter put the finale in Chapter 5, not Chapter 4.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] says the final mission is Chapter 4's Starting From Zero — the same line it gives for Top Of The World, Ma, which looks like a copy error. Other lists word the finale as Chapter 5 [4], and TechWiser's Chapter 5 mission list ends with The End of the Road [10]. Both versions are shown here; the trophy itself is unaffected.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time window inside Breakfast Run, but neither PowerPyx nor OutputLag mentions a window here. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time window in this heist set-piece, but neither PowerPyx nor OutputLag mentions a window here. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time errand window mid-mission, but neither PowerPyx nor OutputLag mentions a window here. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time window in this venue set-piece, but neither PowerPyx nor OutputLag mentions a window here. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time window in this takedown, attributed to KeenGamer, but the KeenGamer guide read here does not mention a window. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: WATCH: one entry flags a one-time approach window before the alarm state changes, but neither PowerPyx nor OutputLag mentions a window here. Shown as watch, not missable — the claim is unverified from the guides read.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops as you play the story.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Nothing on the 100% checklist is missable: the list only appears after the story, but progress made during the story still counts.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story. The bar is lenient — about 60% of true completion — and most of it fills up while you earn the other trophies.

steps.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what is left; everything you did during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.
Finish every robbery line in full: all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all 7 Payday Loan jobs and all 8 bank vaults.
Finish the all-or-nothing collectibles: 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting range golds, all 42 drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Hit the partial targets and stop there: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
Do not chase everything: card sets only need 15 of 18, flamingos 100 of 125, and weapons 50 of 66 — the checklist is closer to 60% of true completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; stunts can be done any time in free roam.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.

steps.text: Pick the quickest kind first: the 202 Under the Bridges flights are the fastest way to build the count.
Mix in the other kinds as you travel: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps by parachute.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under the Stunt Spots filter — every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist; the optional challenge shown on each stunt icon is not required.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; every activity type stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Most of them happen on their own while you play the story and work the 100% checklist.

steps.text: Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — the tracker counts 9 types.
Cover the nine: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (score one hoop), playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt.
Use the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) to find the ones you have not tried yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; ranges stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. The number of ranges is disputed (12 vs 2), but every guide agrees on the 42 golds.

steps.text: Visit the shooting ranges and work through their challenges, aiming for gold on each one — 42 gold medals in total.
Use the ranges to raise your Focus level at the same time; a higher Focus level makes Gunslinger much easier.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 golds too, so there is no shortcut past this one — finish it during the checklist grind.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] and GTABase [9] count 12 shooting ranges holding the 42 gold medals; OutputLag [2] says there are two ranges with 42 golds between them. The 42 total is agreed — only the number of locations differs.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; drone races stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so finish each location while you are there.

steps.text: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations around Leonida.
Win at least one race at each location — 14 wins in total.
While you are at a location, run all of its races: the 100% checklist needs all 42 drone races, so the extra wins are not wasted.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; races stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating a race you already won does not count — there are 40 unique races to choose from.

steps.text: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations.
Do not repeat wins: only your first win in each race counts toward the 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Cal's fishing line stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His line opens after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text message — it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map.
Follow Cal's fishing questline through to the challenge and beat him in it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; arcade games stay playable after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game). Finishing all of its levels once is enough — you do not need every challenge.

steps.text: Pick any of the 4 games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around Leonida.
Play it through to the end — finishing all levels once counts as completing it.
If the home TV games are briefly unavailable during a story section, come back later; they stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Andy's line stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line. It is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, take Andy's call and then her text with the home address in Belville.
Work through the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.
Finish Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) — the final quest awards the trophy. The line stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2–3, so the line is not missable.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks and bring it back to him. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

steps.text: Start the line in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton); he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive at the purple treasure-chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the seabed, then bring it back to Kenton — 7 shipwrecks in total.
If Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1, keep playing: he is back in Chapters 2–3 as Jason and texts you. Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can speed his return.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Billy's line stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-job line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through the five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.
Finish Hometown Heroes — the final job awards the trophy. The line stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: DISPUTED: PowerPyx says all stranger strands survive the story; OutputLag and TechWiser flag Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) as time-sensitive. Treat that one race as missable until proven otherwise.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Only some questlines count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand.

steps.text: Finish the Kirk strand (Skunk Ape hunt: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove) — the last hunt is Lucia-only and night-only.
Finish the Kyle strand (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?).
Finish the Yago strand — and do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3: it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive, so save first.
Finish the Pilot Pete strand (The Last Mile jobs and Pete's Deliveries).
Count your strands on the trophy tracker in the trophy list; more qualifying strangers are still being confirmed, so check the counter rather than guessing.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] says every Strangers & Freaks strand is still there after the story; OutputLag [2] and TechWiser [10] flag Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and say the strand counts toward this trophy. Both versions are shown here.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Randy's list can be finished after the story.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). The list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also unlocks the Key Cloner.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — the Zorrusso is delivered as part of the mission and the Key Cloner unlocks.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on the list.
Steal the remaining 15 cars and drive each one to Randy's garage; cars in good condition pay more. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds.
The full list: Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Tyrone's line stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line as Jason: destroy the synthetic labs, then take his final job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs). The exact number of labs is not given in the guides read — the game tells you when enough are gone.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, play as Jason and follow the purple Synthetic Labs markers around Vice City.
Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. The guides do not state how many labs it takes — keep going until Tyrone contacts you.
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), and finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy every guide agrees may be missable. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1; whether the trophy needs it is itself disputed. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

steps.text: DO THIS FIRST, in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning. She says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.

Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until this trophy pops. The balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not settled whether the trophy needs it — every guide that names a possibly missable trophy names only this one.
Meditate at the remaining spots with both characters together whenever you can — each shared spot counts twice. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so the missable spot cannot cost you A Long Road.
Do not skip the balcony step on the grounds that 15 of 18 is enough for 100%: the trophy itself asks for every spot, and the balcony spot is the one whose counting is disputed.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] says it is currently unclear whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy; OutputLag [2] states that it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears after that chapter. GTABase [9] also calls it unconfirmed. Both versions are shown here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; Bret's line stays available after the story. What is NOT settled is which animal triggers the trophy.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still being confirmed — work through all 15 Target Decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, play as Jason and wait for Bret's text; his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), is in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret marks with purple icons and bring them back to him as Jason. A clean one-shot kill (head or heart) keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but is not required.
Keep going through all 15 Target Decks (Map > Activities > Target Deck). The triggering animal is still unconfirmed, so finishing the full set is the honest way to cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; cards stay collectible after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them — so the trophy is the easy part of a long collectible hunt.

steps.text: Pick any 3 card sets and complete them; you do not need all 18 for this trophy.
Check how close each set is under Progress > Collections, and use a card-set location guide for the sets you choose — the trophy guides read here only link out to location lists.
If you are chasing A Long Road as well, keep going to 15 of 18 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; WAiNK spots stay scannable after the story.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up, then R1). Any 100 count, from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — the guides do not state how many tags exist.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on the phone (hold Up) and scan objects in the world by holding R1.
Scan anything: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 spots in total.
Scan as you travel from the start of the game — the same habit feeds Whip It Good and the 100% checklist, which also wants 100 WAiNK scans.
Note: 31 + 35 + 23 is 89, so at least some No Flusher tags are needed to reach 100; the guides read here do not give a tag total, so do not trust a number for them.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; challenges stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there — many challenges finish on their own.

steps.text: Check Progress > Challenges; finished ones show a Completed tick at the bottom right as you scroll.
Leave this for late: most of the 50 will complete themselves while you work on the other trophies, then pick the easiest ones that remain.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it can be done any time in free roam with your partner. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then escape the red heat zone. It only counts once you are out of the heat zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough.

steps.text: Wait until both characters can free-roam together in Chapter 2, then call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause chaos until you reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape on a fast sports bike — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well.
Keep going until you are out of the red heat zone; the trophy pops then. Bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars, so it often pops on its own during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.disagreement: OutputLag [2] says character switching opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; PowerPyx [1] ties it to Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Both missions are Chapter 2, so only the trigger mission differs — the chapter is agreed.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it can be retried any time in free roam with your partner. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted. Keep the wanted level flashing red and blue — if the stars clear, the chain breaks.

steps.text: Wait until both characters can free-roam together in Chapter 2, then call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and stock up on body armor, sticky bombs and healing items.
Rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police are still chasing you. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop. If it does not pop, rob a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; vehicles stay scannable after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. You only need to scan them — driving them is not required. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up), point it at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand by a busy road and scan the traffic going past — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive anything.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, and keep scanning past 100: the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Combat Focus can be used any time in free roam. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Focus only lasts a few seconds, so fill the bar first and pick a crowded target.

steps.text: Fill your Focus bar first: eat or drink, wash up or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to make Focus last longer.
Gather 5 enemies in one place — the thugs at a gang operation work well — and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 for accurate full-auto fire. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover.
Trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and drop all 5 without missing. Soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count, so use gang enemies.
If it does not pop, raise your Focus level first (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots) — at Focus level 4 it often pops on its own during normal play.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: DISPUTED: the guides read here describe a free-roam method and mention no story window. Another entry flags it as possibly missable; that claim could not be verified from the guides cited here. Save before trying, and try it in free roam first.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at VCIA, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count.

steps.text: Go to VCIA and pick a large passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
Get inside, go upstairs into the cockpit, back the plane out to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is delayed — keep flying until it appears. The jet must be docked at a boarding gate; planes parked on the airfield do not count.

trophies.disagreement: No guide read for this list mentions a story window at VCIA; PowerPyx [1] and GTABase [9] describe a free-roam method (docked jet, gates E3/E4, fly 1 km). The possibly-missable claim comes from another entry's reading, not from a guide cited here.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the tank can be stolen any time in free roam. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map in Mariana County, and take out enemies from inside it.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County; the tanks stand at the south end of the base, on the island at the far south-west of the map.
Get in through the gate, or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Save first — the base is guarded.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: if you are spotted, reload and try again. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking and opens jewelry store robberies.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun. It stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping, and the same mission opens jewelry store robberies.
Pick a jewelry store (green icon on the map in unfogged areas) and enter through the locked back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well, and the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vaults can be robbed again after the mission that opens them. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open.

steps.text: Finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). It is marked automatically from story progress and walks you through the first vault robbery.

Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then go in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner — one character cannot carry all the cash (hold Right to hand off a bag). The vault job always brings a 4-star wanted level.
After the mission, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 — he marks security vans with a purple icon. If you have not done his earlier quests, rob 2 Payday Loans first.
Expect a 4-star wanted level on every vault job: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles so you are no longer recognised. Each vault pays up to $205,000.
Rob any 5 vaults for the trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 8, and the map icon of each vault shows whether you have robbed it.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it pops automatically during the bank-vault mission, and armored trucks can be robbed in free roam. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the bank-vault mission itself: tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts.

steps.text: Do the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail the armored truck to the bank, rob the vault, then escape the red heat zone (or reach a Pay 'n' Spray).

For an earlier method, find an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, block its path, stick a bomb on its back doors and blow them open — sticky bombs are behind Yasmani's shop after his quests.
The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius, not when you open the truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; the map stays open after the story.
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas, as counted by the PSN trophy tracker. Flying is the quickest way.

steps.text: Take a plane and fly over every dark, fogged patch of the map until it is all visible.
The PSN tracker counts 52 areas; the trophy pops once the last one is uncovered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: gang operations stay available after the story. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them.

steps.text: Look for yellow icons on the map when you get near a gang operation; many are also marked automatically from story progress.
Rob one operation per gang — 9 gangs, 9 robberies for the trophy.
Track progress under Progress > Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows, bottom right, how many of its operations you have robbed. Keep going to all 39 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window. What is disputed is whether the method below is confirmed at all.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx gives a concrete method; three other sources list the trigger as not yet confirmed — both versions are shown.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
If it does not pop, do not invent another method: OutputLag, GTABase and KeenGamer all list this trigger as not yet confirmed, so the PowerPyx method is the best lead, not a certainty.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] gives a method (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini); OutputLag [2], GTABase [9] and KeenGamer [3] list the trigger as not yet confirmed. Both versions are shown here.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: once you have the Key Cloner, the showroom can be revisited. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.) What is disputed is whether the method below is confirmed at all.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. PowerPyx gives this method; three other sources list the trigger as not yet confirmed.

steps.text: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — the Banshee cannot be stolen before that.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City, break into the blue Banshee with the Key Cloner, and drive straight forward through the window.

The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving away down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts; it is an easter egg for the Banshee from GTA III. If it does not pop, note that OutputLag, GTABase and KeenGamer list this trigger as not yet confirmed.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] gives a method (blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom, after the Key Cloner); OutputLag [2], GTABase [9] and KeenGamer [3] list the trigger as not yet confirmed. Both versions are shown here.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; the robbery icon comes back after a long time, so missed items can be collected later.
trophies.guide: Take the 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — the Kolt & Associates alley, a gang operation — and then escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. It is first marked by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first — you need them for the safe.

Take the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open with a sticky bomb).
Escape the police — the trophy pops when you lose them, not when you pick up the third item. If you missed an item, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest.
Killing the enemies inside is not required for the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; gyms stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason AND Lucia at the same time. Only possible once both characters are playable together in Chapter 2. Always train together — while one trains, the other trains too.

steps.text: Wait until both characters are playable together in Chapter 2, then check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon).
Buy a fitness club membership and work out there. Filter fitness clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City.
Always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them). Training together trains both at once, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the counter fills passively across the whole game. (An older version of this guide wrongly called it missable.)
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It fills up passively while you earn the other trophies — turn on the profile notifications and let it come to you.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On). A small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever your reputation changes.
Check your count by clicking this trophy in the trophy list. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts toward the 500.

Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and police get more aggressive. If you are short at the end, the guides suggest farming it by running over civilians and police — but that is exactly how you reach Irredeemable, so weigh it before you do.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window — but no guide knows the trigger either, so nothing about this trophy can be called safe or missable yet.
trophies.guide: TRIGGER NOT KNOWN. No guide read for this list has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx only offers a guess (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue). This guide will not invent steps for it.

steps.text: TRIGGER NOT KNOWN — do not follow any method for this trophy yet. PowerPyx [1], OutputLag [2], GTABase [9] and KeenGamer [3] all list it as unconfirmed; the only lead is a guess that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window. What is disputed is whether the method below is confirmed at all — the spawn is described as random.
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx gives a concrete method; three other sources list the trigger as not yet confirmed — both versions are shown.

steps.text: Go alone, at night after 2am, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed — if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

From the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
If it does not work, stop: OutputLag, GTABase and KeenGamer list this trigger as not yet confirmed, so treat the method above as the best lead, not a certainty.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx [1] gives a method (UFO easter egg, road north-west of Starlet Motel after 2am, alone); OutputLag [2], GTABase [9] and KeenGamer [3] list the trigger as not yet confirmed. Both versions are shown here.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window — but no guide knows the trigger either, so nothing about this trophy can be called safe or missable yet.
trophies.guide: TRIGGER NOT KNOWN. No guide read for this list has confirmed how this trophy unlocks. PowerPyx only offers a guess (believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle). This guide will not invent steps for it.

steps.text: TRIGGER NOT KNOWN — do not follow any method for this trophy yet. PowerPyx [1], OutputLag [2], GTABase [9] and KeenGamer [3] all list it as unconfirmed; the only lead is a guess about kicking enemies from a motorcycle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; marked bills can be laundered any time after the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is a running total across all robberies, not a single delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so the robberies for the 100% checklist get you most of the way there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; shops stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop — the total is cumulative, not a single purchase.

Buy the expensive things first: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
This fills up on its own while you gear up for the other trophies — check your spending only if it has not popped by the end.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; garages stay buyable after the story.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for about $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). You get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy the 8 garages through the app, about $160,000 in total. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the quickest way to raise the money.
Do not count the 4 story garages: only the 8 purchasable ones count toward the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: No guide reports a missable window; registrations stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need free garage space first — buy garages (see Little Boxes).

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to get the Scooter Bros app.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage choose Respray and then Register.

At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes, and keep a free garage space for each one.
